## What this changes

## Checklist
- [ ] `python3 scripts/sync_references.py --check` passes
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_catalog.py` passes
- [ ] No copyrighted standard text (ISO, AICPA): IDs and own-words summaries only
- [ ] No real company, customer or personal data
- [ ] Skills never fill in approval fields or claim an organisation "is compliant"
- [ ] Framework facts changed? Source linked below and `as_of` updated
- [ ] Skill behaviour changed? `metadata.version` bumped
- [ ] New skill, or behaviour changed? `README.md` skill page added or updated (fictional example only)
- [ ] Want credit? `contributors/<handle>.md` added and handle in `metadata.author`
- [ ] Tested in at least one agent
